summary: Refuse collection membership paging when the serving daemon lacks the complete capability

rules.detail: The selected API still requires existing read authorization.

compatibility.detail: Explicit Rust, Swift and TypeScript collection-v1 entrypoints require ordered-memberships.paging.v1 version 1 granted before sending a page request or selected subscription. Legacy entrypoints are unchanged.

manual.detail: Use Client::subscribe_ordered_memberships_collection_v1 with the Rust stream. Await the TypeScript selected subscription before requesting pages; its promise resolves only after the socket has sent the command.

recovery.detail: Missing, ungranted or unsupported capability support is a protocol refusal, never a downgrade or an empty collection. Selected responses still require complete epoch metadata. Capability advertisement remains gated by acceptance.
